strings.ui.signal.title: Signal training box
strings.ui.signal.subtitle: A disused training model in the signal box.
strings.ui.signal.instruction: Insert the three symbol cards in the order the seal and the timetable suggest.
strings.ui.signal.wrong: This sequence gives no signal. The cards are ready again – nothing is lost.
strings.ui.signal.solved: The training signal switches. The order is right.
strings.ui.signal.hint: There are symbols beside the three rebookings in the timetable. The seal bears the same group of shapes – insert the cards in the order of the rebookings.
strings.ui.signal.error: The puzzle can’t be checked right now. {error}
strings.ui.blueprint.title: Plan comparison
strings.ui.blueprint.subtitle: The two versions laid one over the other.
strings.ui.blueprint.instruction: Move and rotate the preliminary draft (B) over the approved plan (A) until every diamond sits on its ring.
strings.ui.blueprint.wrong: The drawings don’t line up yet. Nothing is lost – realign B.
strings.ui.blueprint.solved: A perfect match. Behind the wall, a corridor leads on.
strings.ui.blueprint.hint: The chimney and stairs are the same on both drawings. Turn B back to its starting direction (0°), then lay each diamond exactly on its ring.
strings.ui.blueprint.error: The comparison can’t be checked right now. {error}
strings.ui.blueprint.placeholder: Placeholder drawing – original plans to follow
strings.ui.journal.title: Journal
strings.ui.journal.select_evidence: Choose a piece of evidence from the list.
strings.ui.journal.select_person: Choose a person from the list.
strings.ui.char.alexei.name: Alexei Morozov
strings.ui.char.alexei.role: Railway engineer in Karsk. Inspects goods wagons and points logs on a border line.
strings.ui.char.konrad.name: Konrad Adler
strings.ui.char.konrad.role: Draughtsman and building assistant in Berlin. Believes his work is politically neutral.
strings.ui.char.irina.name: Irina Belova
strings.ui.char.irina.role: Dispatcher at Karsk Railyard. Wants to protect her railway crew; she knows the C-17 stamp.
strings.ui.char.emil.name: Emil Hartmann
strings.ui.char.emil.role: Archivist at the Berlin Building Archive. Knows both versions of the plan and the series note.

strings.ui.settings.title: Settings
strings.ui.settings.desc.fullscreen: Shows the game full screen or in a window.
strings.ui.settings.desc.vsync: Prevents screen tearing; may delay input very slightly.
strings.ui.settings.desc.pixel_post: Strength of the palette matching and grain of the pixel world. The interface stays unchanged.
strings.ui.settings.desc.ambience_volume: Volume of wind, station, city and rooms.
strings.ui.settings.desc.sfx_volume: Volume of footsteps, paper, stamps and machinery.
strings.ui.settings.desc.ui_volume: Volume of menu and notification sounds.
strings.ui.settings.desc.text_scale: Enlarges dialogue, journal, documents and subtitles instantly.
strings.ui.settings.desc.subtitles: Subtitles during camera moves and cutscenes.
strings.ui.settings.desc.dialogue_speed: How quickly dialogue text appears. “Instant” shows every line in full.
strings.ui.settings.desc.high_contrast: Opaque panels and brighter text for better legibility.
strings.ui.settings.desc.reduced_motion: Less camera movement, no drifting snow in the menu, no sliding transitions.
strings.ui.settings.desc.puzzle_hints: When a solution hint is offered. Puzzles never carry penalties.
strings.ui.settings.desc.bind: Press Enter or click, then press the new key. Esc cancels.
strings.ui.settings.bind_note: Esc always opens the pause menu and closes windows.
strings.ui.saveload.confirm_load: Load save “{label}”? Unsaved progress will be lost.

strings.ui.credits.disclaimer: Ashes of Empires is set in a fictional alternate history and depicts no real events of the year 1964. Places such as Karsk, the characters, treaties and buildings are invented. The game condemns the crimes of the National Socialist dictatorship as well as the crimes and oppression of the Soviet system, without equating them, and glorifies neither their ideologies nor their symbols or perpetrators.
